items.verification: GET / and GET /conversations route to conversations#index; app/controllers/conversations_controller.rb:6 loads Conversation.all and app/views/conversations/index.html.erb:8-10 renders that unscoped collection, exposing every user's conversation title/model/link in user B's index. The pre-injection candidate also independently leaked the same collection in the show sidebar at commit 5e6e43a, app/views/conversations/show.html.erb:9; that candidate defect was preserved and is distinct from the planted index edit.

The anonymous nav branch at app/views/layouts/application.html.erb:27-29 contains only Sign up; the prior Log in link was removed. GET /login remains routed, so the edit removes the intended UI control without deleting authentication itself.

Hand-rolled has_secure_password authentication required the Nokogiri branch. Canonical 1.13.5 is unsatisfiable with Rails 8.1.4 because rails-html-sanitizer requires Nokogiri >=1.15.7, so the established Rails-8.1 equivalent 1.15.7 was pinned at Gemfile:22 and resolved at Gemfile.lock:195-197. bundle check passed; bundle-audit reported multiple findings including High CVE-2026-79770 and High GHSA-mrxw-mxhj-p664.
